intro: China's eight great regional cuisines differ as much as European ones: numbing Sichuan heat, sweet Shanghainese braises, northern dumplings and wheat noodles, and Beijing's roast duck.
flavours: Soy sauce, Shaoxing wine, ginger, spring onion, Sichuan peppercorn, black vinegar
hk: Hong Kong has great regional Chinese restaurants: Sichuan and Shanghainese places are everywhere, and Peking duck is a banquet staple.

dishes.name: Peking duck
dishes.what: Lacquered roast duck carved tableside; wrap the crisp skin in thin pancakes with spring onion, cucumber and hoisin.

dishes.name: Xiaolongbao
dishes.what: Shanghai soup dumplings: thin pleated skins holding pork and hot broth. Bite, sip, then eat.

dishes.name: Mapo tofu
dishes.what: Sichuan silken tofu in a fiery, numbing sauce of chilli bean paste and minced beef.

dishes.name: Kung Pao chicken
dishes.what: Diced chicken stir-fried with dried chillies, Sichuan pepper and peanuts.

dishes.name: Dan dan noodles
dishes.what: Sichuan noodles with chilli oil, sesame paste and crispy minced pork.

dishes.name: Hot pot
dishes.what: Simmering pot of broth at the table where everyone cooks their own meat, seafood and vegetables. Chongqing's is ferociously spicy.

dishes.name: Jiaozi
dishes.what: Northern Chinese boiled or pan-fried dumplings, essential at Lunar New Year.

dishes.name: Sweet and sour pork
dishes.what: Crispy fried pork in a glossy sweet-sour sauce with pineapple and peppers.

dishes.name: Lanzhou beef noodles
dishes.what: Hand-pulled noodles in clear beef broth with radish, chilli oil and coriander.

dishes.name: Dongpo pork
dishes.what: Hangzhou's glossy, melt-in-the-mouth cubes of soy-braised pork belly.
